news.title: University from world's second-richest country ranks 3rd globally for condensed matter physics
news.content: Singapore's Nanyang Technological University (NTU) ranks third globally for condensed matter physics in the latest U.S. News Best Global Universities rankings.

news.title: Chinese nationals face 40 years over kidnapping of Singaporean at Malaysia airport
news.content: They face one count under Section 3(1) of the Kidnapping Act 1961, read with Section 34 of the Penal Code, which covers acts carried out with common intention. Conviction carries 30 to 40 years in prison and caning.
